parameters.query:
UPDATE notifications SET tentatives = tentatives + 1
WHERE id IN (
    SELECT id FROM notifications
    WHERE statut = 'a_envoyer' AND tentatives < 5
    ORDER BY cree_le
    LIMIT 20
    FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED)
RETURNING id, canal, destinataire, sujet, corps, type, tentatives
UPDATE notifications SET statut = 'envoye', envoye_le = now(), erreur = NULL WHERE id = $1::uuid
UPDATE notifications SET statut = CASE WHEN tentatives >= 5 THEN 'echec' ELSE 'a_envoyer' END, erreur = left($2, 500) WHERE id = $1::uuid
UPDATE notifications SET statut = 'echec', erreur = 'SMS non activé : pas encore de passerelle SMS Le Rebond' WHERE id = $1::uuid
